authorizationUrlParams.description: Extra query parameters added to authorization URLs.

claims.description: Additional claims included in the client assertion.

type.description: OAuth client assertion type. Defaults to urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer. An empty string clears the configured type.

scopes.description: Default scopes to request when token params specify scopes: [\"*\"].

codeChallengeMethod.description: PKCE code challenge method. Supported values are S256 and plain. Vercel prefers S256 when the provider supports it. An empty string clears the configured method.

defaultAudience.description: Default audience used when a token request omits one. An empty string clears the default.

defaultTokenExpiresIn.description: Default token lifetime in seconds to use when the token response omits expires_in.

forwardedClaims.description: Allow-list of extra claims to propagate, keyed by source (idToken). Only claims named here and present in that source are exposed.

enabled.description: Whether this OAuth grant is enabled.

responseType.description: OAuth authorization response type. Defaults to code. Other provider-supported values are accepted. An empty string clears the configured type.

serverConfig.description: Authorization server metadata. Values override discovered metadata. Empty known string fields remove their stored overrides.

knownStale.description: Whether the connector is known to have been edited since the app package it publishes to the provider was last built, so that package no longer matches it. Absent when it was not computed, or when the connector type publishes no such package. Derived on every read rather than marked at edit time, so reverting an edit clears it. Only reported by connector types that publish a package a user has to re-publish by hand — Microsoft Teams today.

redirectUri.description: Redirect URI registered with the third-party service for this connector, if any. Absent on connectors created before this field was introduced; those callers fall back to the `https://connect.vercel.com/callback` default.
